items.title: Traded: Venture Capital on X: "Moonshot AI, a Beijing-based artificial intelligence startup, has closed a $3.5 billion funding round that boosted its valuation to $35 billion, significantly surpassing its original fundraising target of $1 billion to $2 billion. The raise follows the July 16 launch of its Kimi K3 model, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight system that has attracted global attention for its competitive performance in coding and knowledge-work tasks. The company is reportedly seeking additional funding at a $50 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned Hong Kong IPO later this year. Moonshot’s rapid growth is underscored by an eightfold increase in valuation over just six months, while growing adoption of its models by U.S. technology firms has further strengthened investor confidence. FOUNDER: Yang Zhilin INVESTORS: Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan & HSG AMOUNT: $3,500,000,000 VALUATION: $35,000,000,000 HQ: Beijing, China #VentureCapital #MoonshotAI #YangZhilin #TradedVC" / X
